title: MAC Minute — 2026-10-02
description: MAC Fellas, it is Saturday, October third, and the freight landscape is shifting fast. It’s a huge week for capacity, starting with Ethiopian Airlines committing five billion dollars to a new cargo fleet. That massive investment in their Bishoftu hub could reshape African trade lanes and global competition. Meanwhile, Flydubai just launched three dedicated B737-800 freighters to tackle growing e-commerce demand. That gives them scheduled capacity for the first time, which might tighten regional bandwidth. On a serious note, NTSB reports Amazon pilots lacked critical wind data in a recent crash. That highlights how vital weather data integration is for all cargo operators today. Watch the Ethiopian hub expansion closely; it’s a major structural shift in the market.

sources.title: Ethiopian Airlines spends $5bn on cargo fleet as its Bishoftu hub takes shape - The Africa Report
Flydubai Cargo unveils routes for freighter network launch
Pilots of crashed Amazon cargo plane were unaware of wind conditions - Reuters
